label: sequence began with digit 3 (late original phase through <DEL>)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase from step 3 onward, and at the <DEL> step, in sequences whose first original token is the digit 3 (first_tok=3 has 21x lift and holds 93% of activation mass). It is a persistent memory of an initial 3 that the model will have to output at <DEL>. It almost never fires in the copy phase (46 of 104k activations) or at steps 0-2. Magnitude is largest when the sequence starts 3 3 (all top examples), and it usually peaks around steps 4-5. Weaker activations (about 7% of mass) occur when 3 is the second original token. False positives are mostly sequences like 3 x 3 at step 3, where the feature turns on a step late.

issues: Recall by count is only 0.71 on test, but mass recall is 0.93. Nearly all of the 29.5k missed steps (7.4% of mass) are weak activations where 3 is the second original token. The explanation already says this.

That second-position class is noisy and cannot be added cleanly. The predicate orig(1)==3 & first_tok!=3 & phase<=1 & t>=3 alone gets precision 0.35, recall 0.25 and mass recall 0.07. OR-ing it into the original predicate raises mass recall to 0.996 but lowers F1 to 0.79 (precision 0.68). Splitting it by t, L or whether the first token is a letter or digit gives no clean subclass.
After that, the remaining misses hold 0.4% of mass. They are scattered tiny activations, many in sequences starting with p (first_tok=p alone: precision 0.06). This is noise, not a systematic class.

The specific claims check out on the dev profile. Copy phase: 46 of 103.8k active steps. Steps 0-1: 0; step 2: 219. Mass share peaks at t=4 (0.28) and t=5 (0.235). All top examples start '3 3', although '3 3' sequences are only 2.4% of the active steps. False positives total 714 and are mainly '3 x 3' at t=3: first_tok=3 & orig(2)=3 & t==3 has precision 0.077, so those steps are mostly inactive.
The label 'sequence began with digit 3' matches the predicate and does not overclaim, given that the second-position caveat is in the explanation.
